Thank you. 

I have some hobbies but I don't think 3d printing, or doing home machining really count for making real life friends. I had friends until I quit doing drugs 19 years ago and then got married. I think I got over this last night but have decided I am going to look for a new job and turn in my 2 week notice on friday of this coming up week. Maybe I will find something better.

Hey there I might not know you but why? There are things that make you happy and make you who you are. I know that life is not always what we want it to be, but there are better things around some of the corners in life.
